name: FurHouse
source:
In this Big Brother-inspired furry visual novel, your vote will determine who stays, who goes, and who wins. 12 young adults enter the FurHouse with the hopes of winning the 100,000 dollar grand prize. With no access to their phones or the outside world, they must brave social challenges, constant camera surveillance, and each other in order to make it through. Every two weeks, an episode of FurHouse will be released. Contestants will be put up for elimination and the collective vote of all of the readers will determine who goes home.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/furhouse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部受老大哥启发的毛茸茸视觉小说中，你的投票将决定谁留下、谁离开以及谁获胜。12名年轻人进入FurHouse，希望赢得10万美元的大奖。由于无法使用手机或接触外界，他们必须勇敢地面对社交挑战、持续的摄像头监控以及彼此之间的关系，才能渡过难关。每两周就会发布一集FurHouse。参赛者将被淘汰，所有读者的集体投票将决定谁回家。

[来自[url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/furhouse]Itch.io[/url]]
